style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2m Pre Lit Oversized Mistletoe Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Fill your home with love this Christmas with our extra-large mistletoe garland. At 2m in length, this neutral decoration is an oversized version of our mistletoe garland and features a sturdy real twig frame and thick and full foliage for a luxurious and elegant finish.</p><p>With frosted faux foliage and white pearl berries, the garland is a timeless décor piece that can be loved for many years to come. Pre-lit with 50 warm white micro LEDs, style your garland across your dining table or ascending your staircase to add a warm seasonal sparkle to your home.</p><p>Perfect for pairing with our matching oversized mistletoe wreath, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the battery box and choose the optional 6-hour timer function for an automatic glow night after night. Size: ONE.</p>
